newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures stick mostly firmer.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures stick mostly firmer.

text.p: June 16 - IMM currency futures mostly firmer in still-calm pit trading. News near the pit opening of an EMU budget pact briefly lifted marks but had limited impact. Some waited to see whether May US CPI Tues confirms tame inflation, bolsters ideas of no US tightening in July. Yen up on rate-hike rumors, edginess about this week's U.S., Japan trade data, G7 meet.
